description: Four attack-decay envelope generators with an exponential shape, each free-running as a looping low-frequency oscillator while its trigger input is unpatched

params.text: Sets the rise time of that channel, the climb from zero to the maximum level
Sets the fall time of that channel, the drop from the maximum level back to zero
Picks that channel's time range: the fastest is a rise of 0.1ms to 400ms and a fall of 0.1ms to 600ms, middle ten times longer, slowest a hundred, despite the tooltip naming it a frequency divider

inputs.text: A trigger or gate here fires that channel's envelope; with nothing patched the channel loops instead, the fall retriggering the rise

outputs.text: The envelope of that channel, 0-9V when it is triggered and 1-9V while it free-runs

notes: a channel with nothing patched into its trigger input runs as a looping low-frequency oscillator, so it needs no trigger to start.
